settings.title: Built in the open.
settings.subheading: Every figure we publish carries its source. Where we don't have one, we say so instead of guessing.

settings.text: We make apparel for women and men, and we publish the details that usually stay hidden — fabric weight, composition, how a seam is finished. Not because it makes good marketing, but because it is what we would want to read before buying. When a figure isn't confirmed by a supplier, we leave the space empty rather than fill it.

settings.subtitle: Construction
settings.text:
The parts you can't see

A flat-lock seam lies flat against the skin instead of standing proud of it. That is the difference between a garment you forget you are wearing and one you notice all day.

We photograph construction close because it is the part of a garment that decides how it feels after an hour, and it is the part that pictures of people wearing clothes never show. Where we can state a construction detail, we state it. Where we cannot, that space stays empty.

settings.subtitle: Fit
settings.text:
Fit before flourish

Sizing is where most stores quietly guess. A chart gets copied from somewhere, converted between systems, and published as though it had been measured.

We would rather show you the grade we build to and tell you plainly that it is a grade, not the measurement of a specific garment. When pieces are in production, their own measurements go on their pages, and those measurements govern.

settings.title: What does HIVOLT sell?
settings.text: Apparel for women and men. The catalogue is being rebuilt, and pieces appear here as they are confirmed.

settings.title: How long do I have to return something?
settings.text: 60 days from delivery, on every order, with a free return label and no restocking fee. The window is confirmed; the operational detail behind it is still being finalised with our fulfilment partner.

settings.title: What does shipping cost?
settings.text: Nothing. Shipping is free on every US order with no minimum spend — that is set in our checkout, not a promotion.

settings.title: Why are some figures on this site missing?
settings.text: Because the number that belongs there is not confirmed yet. We would rather publish a gap than a guess, and the gap closes as soon as the figure has a source.
